instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, eye-level medium-full shot. Against a yellow brick wall background with parked shopping carts, the man in the red beanie (R1), wearing a beige jacket and blue jeans, stands bending forward. He is giving a piggyback ride to the woman in the rainbow beanie (R2), who wears a beige fleece hoodie and black pants. The woman clings to his back with her arms wrapped around his shoulders, laughing and looking down at him. Warm, direct lighting illuminates the pair, casting soft shadows on the brick wall behind them.
